telegram.start: Hi! To use this bot, open PP Agent › Settings › Channels › Telegram, start pairing, then send me /pair followed by the code.
telegram.startPaired: Hi {{name}}! Send me a message and I will get to work. /help lists the commands.
telegram.help:
Send text, photos, files or voice messages.
/new – start a new conversation
/agent – choose the agent that answers
/workspace – choose the workspace it works in
/model – choose the model
/thinking – choose how much it thinks
/research <question> – research a question and get a report (quick or deep before the question sets how thorough)
/stop – stop what I am doing
/sessions – list saved conversations
/resume <number> – switch to a saved conversation
/id – show this chat's id
/help – show this help
